description: Verify that after the Probe listen window expires without conflict, DUT broadcasts a Gratuitous ARP Reply announcing the bound IP (RFC 2131 §4.4.1 SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
If the ARP Probe phase passes silently, the address is the DUT's. Per RFC 2131 §4.4.1 the client SHOULD then broadcast a Gratuitous ARP Reply so every host on the segment updates its ARP cache to the new mapping.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND → DUT-emitted ARP Probe.
2. Probe listen window passes with NO conflict.
3. DUT → wire: Gratuitous ARP Reply (sender == target == bound IP, broadcast Eth dst)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Gratuitous ARP Reply with the expected fields lands within the deadline.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request / Fail_no_arp_probe — DORA / Probe missing
• Fail_no_announce — DUT did not emit the Gratuitous ARP Reply after the silent Probe phase

verdicts.Pass: DUT broadcast Gratuitous ARP Reply post-Probe — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_arp_probe: No DUT ARP Probe after BOUND
verdicts.Fail_no_announce: No DUT ARP Reply announce after Probe
